reuse.why: Extends the shared getScheduledAmount, but recomputes the tolerance as Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075) instead of calling the existing getApproxNumberThreshold in shared/rules.ts that matching uses.

duplication.why: The 7.5% tolerance formula is duplicated from getApproxNumberThreshold, so matching and planning tolerances can drift apart.

placement.why: The rule is put in shared/schedules.ts where schedule amount semantics live; adding an op argument to the shared helper is the right layer.

scope.why: Only the helper, the server call sites and tests are touched.

maintainability.why: The op is an optional trailing parameter defaulting to 'is' behind a positional boolean, so the many client call sites (SchedulesTable, Balance, mobile list, useScheduleEdit) silently keep the old rule and future callers can easily forget it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount recomputes the approximate tolerance instead of using getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.ts

disguised_duplication.where: getScheduledAmount's Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075) inlines getApproxNumberThreshold's body inside a sign-adjusted expression

one_place.where: Rule lives in getScheduledAmount but only applies when callers pass the op; server sites pass it, desktop-client SchedulesTable, Balance, MobileSchedulesPage, SchedulesListItem and useScheduleEdit still call getScheduledAmount(amount) without it
